name: MarketMan
oneLiner: Cloud inventory, purchasing and food cost platform for restaurants, covering counts, recipe costing, supplier ordering and invoice processing.
bestFor: Independent restaurants and multi-unit groups that want tighter control of inventory, purchasing and food cost, including Square sellers via the Square integration.

updates.text: Square launched Square Restaurant Inventory by MarketMan globally, bringing ingredient and recipe management, purchase orders, vendor management, invoice scanning and waste tracking into the Square platform.

features: Real-time inventory tracking and counts by location
Recipe and menu costing linked to current ingredient prices
Automated purchase orders and supplier ordering
Invoice scanning with automatic price updates and price-change alerts
POS and accounting integrations, including Square
Multi-location reporting on food cost and COGS
API access add-on for larger groups

pricing.text: Not confirmed on MarketMan's site in this research; third-party trackers list Starter and Growth plans per location and report price increases in August 2026. Ask MarketMan for a quote.

notes: Dropped from current review: 'approximately $239/month per location' (third-party sources conflict: $199-$299 Starter/Growth, Enterprise from $449; a tracker reports Aug 2026 price hikes). Dropped Bareburger, Dickey's Barbecue Pit and Thunderbird Food & Drink as customers (not re-confirmed). Customer stories found are vendor case studies, mostly undated. Third-party reviews are mixed (Capterra 4.7; another aggregator reports stability complaints).
